name: Jeeter Liquid Diamond Disposable | Maple Ice (Limited Edition)
description:
Jeeter All-In-One Diamonds Vapes | Maple Ice | 1G | Indica

The world stage, now in vapor form.

Six countries. Six flavors. One complete lineup.

Designed to pair with the Boutique Drop collectible soccer ball, these Jeeter All-In-One vapes fill the six display slots built into the packaging — turning the full collection into a true centerpiece.

• Canada — Maple Ice (Indica)

Built to collect. Designed to display. Now that’s global flavor.
